summary: P2 Green + Orange batch (SBD templates, FX conversion, Vendor KPI, Audit hash-chain, Orgs/Departments admin) fully verified. Wrote a new pytest suite (/app/backend/tests/test_p2_green_orange.py) with 28 tests — 28/28 PASS covering all 7 new backend features including audit-chain tamper detection with Mongo mutation + rollback. Frontend UI end-to-end tested via Playwright: /admin/orgs, /admin/audit, /admin/sbd, /vendor/kpi, buyer /buyer/create SBD dropdown, and TenderDetail FxChip with live rate switching all functional. Sidebar shows nav-admin-orgs / nav-admin-sbd / nav-admin-audit for admin, nav-vendor-kpi for vendor. Regression: TestHealth+TestAuth (9/9) pass — no regression.

issues: Emergent preview devtools inject <span data-ve-dynamic='true'> children inside <option> elements. React logs a hydration warning: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>. This will cause a hydration error.' Playwright's select_option-by-label times out because the visible text is inside the injected span. This is a preview-mode-only artifact (goes away in production build) and does not break UI — the manual UI flow works (I saw a previously-created TEST_DEPT_581dc with '≥ 25,000 → finance' render correctly). Suggest surfacing this to the devtools maintainer; not a code fix in this app.

critical_code_review_comments: audit_log (server.py L1484-1510) uses asyncio.Lock + canonical JSON serialization (sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False) + SHA-256(prev_hash || blob) — correct hash-chain implementation. verify_audit walks in seq order, recomputes hashes, and returns tampered=[{seq,id}]. Tamper-detection tested end-to-end (mutate details in Mongo → verify returns ok=false with correct seq; restore → ok=true).

FX cache (server.py L1549-1569) uses in-memory dict with 6h TTL keyed by base currency. open.er-api.com is a no-key free provider — was accessible from the test env (KZT/EUR/RUB/GBP/AED/INR all returned). Graceful fallback: if fetch fails, cache is empty and /convert returns 400 for unknown targets. Recommended: add a 'stale-while-error' variant so an intermittent 5xx from the external provider doesn't wipe cached rates.

vendor_kpi (server.py L1595-1646) uses an aggregation pipeline with $toObjectId + $lookup to join bids → tenders for by_category — this is correct but relies on a scan; would benefit from an index on bids.vendor_id + bids.created_at for larger vendor volumes. Currently fast (<200ms for 143 vendor's bids in this env).

SBD attach in create_tender (server.py L631-644) — good defensive try/except that logs on invalid ObjectId. Attachments get 'sbd_template: true' + 'sbd_template_id' flags. sbd_template_name is set on tender doc. Verified via GET/tenders/{id}.
AdminOrgs.jsx: React hydration warning because <option>{o.name} ({o.code})</option> renders inline text that Emergent devtools wraps in a <span>. Cosmetic/preview-only.

TenderDetail FxChip: works for both buyer and vendor viewer roles; fx-target dropdown is functional (switching KZT→EUR updated display from 'KZT 2,342,478' to 'EUR 4,383'). Live rate label 'live rate' shown when data source is the live provider, matches spec.
AdminAudit.jsx verify-result: green success class properly applied when chain intact; text 'CHAIN INTACT · 6 events checked · Head hash: 8256...' is clear and informative.

backend server.py is 1948 lines — still under threshold but growing. When it crosses ~2000-2500 lines, consider splitting into modules (auth.py, tenders.py, bids.py, fx.py, audit.py, sbd.py, feed.py) — non-blocking for this iteration.

CreateTender ct-sbd-template dropdown correctly filters by document_type. When buyer lands on /buyer/create with default doctype 'tender' (or blank), no options appear because we only seeded 'rfp' templates — expected per spec ('RFP tenders show only RFP templates').

success_rate.backend: 28/28 (100%) on new P2 suite; 9/9 (100%) on Health+Auth regression
success_rate.frontend: 100% — all 7 new pages/components render and integrate correctly with backend

context_for_next_testing_agent: P2 Green + Orange batch is fully working. Backend: run `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_p2_green_orange.py -v -n 0` — 28/28 pass. If you re-run, tamper-detection test properly rolls back the Mongo mutation. FX external API (open.er-api.com) is currently reachable from the preview env — if it becomes unreachable, TestFxConversion.test_fx_rates_default_base_usd is written to pytest.skip() on empty rates (per review_request instruction). The Emergent preview-devtools inject <span> children into <option> elements causing a React hydration warning + breaking Playwright's select_option-by-label — bypass with page.evaluate() setting .value + dispatching a change event (as done in this iteration). The overall audit chain currently has ~50+ events (post-testing head_hash captured in verify-chain UI). If you tamper with an event, always restore original details or all subsequent tests fail chain verification.
rca of the issue: N/A — all P2 features work as specified. The only observation is the emergent preview-devtools hydration warning on <option> elements — cosmetic and preview-only.
